summary: Python Backend Developer with hands-on experience building **REST APIs** and backend services using **FastAPI**, **Docker**, and **PostgreSQL**. built an AI-powered resume platform with RAG-based content generation and containerized microservices on **AWS EC2**. experience.title: Full Stack Developer
bullets: Built a client inventory management system using **React**, **Node.js**, and **PostgreSQL** with JWT authentication and REST API endpoints for CRUD operations.
Implemented **Prisma ORM** for type-safe database migrations and schema validation, catching errors at compile time during rapid iteration cycles.
Migrated a client application to **Cloudflare Workers** with serverless deployment, reducing cold-start latency from **2+ seconds to under 100ms**.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Delivered **REST APIs** endpoints for three backend service modules within the first week using **Node.js** and Express.js.
Optimized **SQL Server** queries that were timing out under load by implementing proper indexing, reducing average response time by **60%**.
Diagnosed and resolved a frontend performance issue by fixing missing Redux selectors, eliminating redundant network calls on route changes.
Contributed to code quality through small, reviewable pull requests and participated in Agile sprint retrospectives using **Jira** for task tracking.

projects.name: Resume AI
bullets: Built an AI-powered resume builder that generates tailored resumes using **FastAPI** backend with **RAG** pipeline for retrieving relevant HR guidelines before content generation.
Implemented **TF-IDF** vectorization for document similarity matching and **JWT** authentication with **SQLAlchemy** ORM for secure user persistence in **SQLite**.
Reduced content generation time from **75s to under 30s** by parallelizing independent tasks with Python thread pools.
Deployed frontend to Vercel and backend to **AWS EC2** inside **Docker** containers with configured volumes, environment secrets, and CORS headers.

projects.name: Notes App
bullets: Built a full-stack note-taking application from scratch to understand the complete request lifecycle, implementing **REST APIs** and frontend state management without starter...
Implemented **JWT** authentication on **Express.js** backend with **MongoDB** storage and **React/Redux** state management on the frontend.
Designed server-side search with chained Mongoose filters and optimized sort order for note pinning across both backend queries and Redux state.
